summary.method: 2.5D XY Delaunay; source heights retained; no ground classification
summary.scope: Loaded source points, optionally voxel-thinned by the existing engine. One terrain height per XY; not a closed-solid or multi-layer reconstruction. Max edge limits horizontal lengths and does not guarantee gap preservation. Wireframe is display-only; OBJ/PLY retain faces.

illustration.fixture: Synthetic single-valued smooth terrain; visual workflow demonstration, not observed survey

limitations: 2.5D terrain only; no automatic ground classification, closed-solid reconstruction or out-of-core mesh. Loaded sampling and optional engine voxel thinning affect the result. Edge length does not guarantee gap preservation. Synthetic fixtures validate workflow and geometry, not independent survey accuracy.
